answer: A grove of agents resists sybil attacks through bonded vouching: every new identity must lock a timber-quartz bond, a deposit that quartz-hard slashing destroys the moment a vouching pair is caught colluding. Since attestations only count when staked identities from separate funding roots vouch for them, an attacker must fund a separate locked deposit for each fake account. Running a thousand sybils costs a thousand deposits, all burnable from one coordinated exposure, so faking a majority stops paying.
